episode.title: The First Juggling Ball
episode.scene: A neon-lit carnival tent at night featuring bold black ink outlines and a vivid purple and acid green color palette. A friendly jester wearing a purple and green three-point hat with gold bells, white face paint, a wide grin, green curly hair, and a diamond-patterned tunic is enthusiastically juggling three glowing green balls. Below him on a small wooden stage, a fluffy hamster couple stands side by side, watching with wide, mesmerized eyes and tiny open mouths. String lights glow softly in the background.
episode.caption: Auditioning for the carnival crew! We might just be tiny, but our enthusiasm is huge. 🎪🐹✨
episode.arcNote: The hamster couple met the cheerful jester as he set up his carnival act and watched him juggle.
episode.arcUpdate: The hamsters are now officially part of the carnival's backstage crew.
episode.newRunningGag: The hamsters constantly try to copy whatever the jester is doing with disastrously cute results.
